description: Item difficulty initialisation relative to node: itemInitialElo = nodeElo + tierOffset(tier). Offsets are baked constants derived from doc 05 §2 target p-values (-285, -115, +20), NOT authored fixed values (1200/1500/1800) and NOT computed at runtime.

comparisons.description: Shallow node at base level (COUNT, nodeElo=1200)

assertion: A Tier 1 item on a deep node (1315) is harder than a Tier 3 item on a shallow node (1220). The item difficulty is relative to the node, eliminating the cold-start distortion from fixed tiers.
